aboutLead: I build AI systems end to end: problem framing, system design, production rollout, and the operational detail that makes those systems dependable.
aboutBio: My recent work sits at the intersection of product, applied ML, and platform engineering. I have led enterprise GenAI builds, modernized recommendation systems, and shipped internal copilots for data workflows. The common thread is taking ambiguous, research-heavy work and turning it into software that teams can actually run and trust.
